cards.name: Map the Wastes
cards.oracleText: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Bolster 1. (Choose a creature with the least toughness among creatures you control and put a +1/+1 counter on it.)

cards.name: Map the Frontier
cards.oracleText: Search your library for up to two basic land cards and/or Desert cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

cards.name: Map to Lorthos's Temple
cards.oracleText:
Whenever you complete one of the following objectives, check it off. If all three are checked off, sacrifice Map to Lorthos's Temple. If you do, create a Lorthos, the Tidemaker token.
☐ Diving Gear — An artifact enters the battlefield under your control.
☐ Merfolk — A Merfolk enters the battlefield under your control.
☐ Ritual — You cast an instant or sorcery spell.
